is_anopheles.evidence: The study reviews susceptibility in Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus (page 3, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper is a meta-analysis and systematic review focusing solely on insecticide susceptibility bioassay data (KDT and mortality). Target resistance markers such as L1014F/S are only mentioned in passing in the discussion as background literature citations (page 23).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts or frequencies are reported; all data tables and figures summarize bioassay knockdown times (KDT50/KDT95) and 24-hour mortality rates from published literature (pages 51-63, Tables 1 and 2).

african_field_population.evidence: The reviewed literature evaluates field-collected Anopheles mosquitoes across various African countries (page 3, Abstract).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a secondary study, explicitly titled and structured as a 'Meta-analysis and Systemic review' following PRISMA guidelines to synthesize data from 50 previously published articles (pages 3, 7-11).

sub_country_location.evidence: The meta-analysis pools data by broad African geographical regions (West Africa, East Africa, South Africa, Central Africa) rather than specific sub-country collection localities (pages 53-58, Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Data are pooled into broad 4-to-5-year multi-year bins (2002-2005, 2006-2010, 2011-2015, 2016-2021) or aggregated across the entire 2002-2021 timeframe (pages 59-63, Table 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; this is a review paper synthesizing secondary data from 50 primary studies.

supplement.evidence: The paper is ineligible as a non-primary systematic review and meta-analysis of bioassays without marker genotyping.

assessment.summary: This article is a systematic review and meta-analysis compiling WHO susceptibility bioassay results (knockdown times and 24-hour mortality) for Anopheles gambiae s.l. and An. funestus across Africa from 2002 to 2021. It does not conduct primary research or generate/report extractable genotype data for target resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: Study is a systematic review and meta-analysis, not a primary empirical study
Does not test or report target insecticide resistance markers
No extractable genotype or allele frequency data reported
